svg.aria-label: Figure 2: bi-temporal remote sensing change detection architecture. A U-shaped diagram. Top row: a frozen ImageNet ResNet-50 encoder, drawn hatched, applied with shared weights to both input images: stem 64 channels at H/4, then layer1 256 at H/4, layer2 512 at H/8, layer3 1024 at H/16, layer4 2048 at H/32. Each of layer1 to layer4 contains a stacked per-domain adapter sub-box on the main path, holding 3, 4, 6 and 3 residual adapters respectively, one after every ResNet bottleneck block, 16 per domain across the two domains LEVIR-CD and WHU-CD; the adapted output feeds both the next stage and the fusion tap. Backbone BatchNorm is kept in eval mode. A thin dashed domain ID bus enters from above and taps every per-domain element: the four encoder adapter sub-boxes and the five decoder stages. Middle row: four fusion boxes concatenate f1, f2 and the absolute difference at every scale, giving 768 channels at 128 squared, 1536 at 64 squared, 3072 at 32 squared and 6144 at 16 squared. The decoder runs right to left below and every stage is per-domain stacked: a 1x1 bottleneck to 512 channels at 16 squared, then three stride-2 transposed-convolution up-stages taking dashed fused skips from fusion levels 3, 2 and 1, merging 3584 to 256, 1792 to 128 and 896 to 64 channels, then a single stride-4 up-stage with no skip merging 64 to 32 channels at 512 squared. Every up-stage uses two DomainConvBlocks. A main 1x1 head emits 1-channel logits at 512 squared; a dashed training-only auxiliary head on the first up-stage uses a 1x1 convolution and bilinear upsampling by 16. A loss box below combines 0.3 times focal BCE with gamma 2 and per-domain positive weight plus 0.7 times Dice, with total loss equal to main loss plus 0.4 times auxiliary loss. Two inset boxes detail the ResidualAdapter and the DomainConvBlock.
svg.title: Figure 2. Multi-domain bi-temporal change detection: frozen ResNet-50 encoder with in-path per-domain residual adapters, tri-stream fusion at every scale, and a shared U-Net decoder with per-domain BatchNorm and adapters.

g.text: L = 0.3 · FocalBCE( gamma=2, pos_weight per domain ) + 0.7 · Dice
